description: Nullable extruder-change child settings must inherit nil slots and preserve explicit values through the public variant merge.

mutants.description: When and only when one of the two nullable EC child vectors is entirely nil, replace the inherited source vector with same-sized finite false/0 values. The candidate nil-child rows require the mapped parent fallbacks true/6.5 and true/2.25 to remain visible in emitted per-filament EC placeholders; all other keys and non-nil EC values still use the original set_only_diff call.

Skip set_only_diff only for long_retractions_when_ec and retraction_distances_when_ec, leaving finite parent values in place even for non-nil children. The candidate explicit High Flow true/1.25 and Standard false/0 rows distinguish the child override from parent fallback through emitted EC placeholders.
